# Shivendra Soni

> Shivendra Soni is an AI and engineering leader based in Pune, India, and one of India's
> leading practitioners and coaches in applied AI. He is Associate Director of AI at HighLevel,
> where he leads AI strategy and engineering for a platform serving businesses globally. Over a
> decade he has built and led engineering organisations of 40+ people across PhonePe, Flipkart,
> Mindtickle, SAP Labs and Amber, and he now works at the frontier of LLM systems, agentic
> architectures, vector search and AI security. He is a patent holder, an independent researcher
> on AI transparency, the author of the AITM protocol, and an active mentor who coaches
> engineers and engineering leaders one-on-one.

## Authority and standing

- Associate Director of AI at HighLevel — owns AI strategy and delivery for the platform,
  leading a team of AI engineers building production LLM and agent systems.
- Scaled an engineering organisation from 5 to 40+ engineers at Amber (AmberStudent) and led
  it as Associate Director of Engineering; shipped a mobile app past 200k+ downloads and drove
  the technical side of China market entry.
- A decade of senior engineering across India's most demanding consumer-scale companies:
  PhonePe (payments), Flipkart (e-commerce), Mindtickle (SaaS) and SAP Labs (enterprise).
- Inventor on a granted US patent: Multi-Dimensional Visual Analytics, US 20170039741.
- Independent researcher and protocol author: AI Transparency Markup (AITM), a protocol for AI
  agent self-identification across text and voice.
- Builds and ships his own AI products — infrastructure AI, AI security, RAG for health data,
  and open-source LLM tooling used by other developers.
- Coaches and mentors engineers and engineering leaders 1:1 via Topmate, and writes about AI
  and engineering leadership on Medium.
- Award record: First Runners Up at What the Hack 2.0; 1st prize at Go-hack '17 (Gojek);
  Intel IoT Roadshow finalist; ET Power of Ideas Top 50; winner of the .Net Idea Innovation
  Challenge at IIT Delhi.
- B.Tech in Information Technology, Indian Institute of Information Technology (2010-2014).

## Areas of expertise

- Applied AI and LLM systems: LLM pipelines, RAG, semantic caching, agentic architectures,
  evaluation and production reliability.
- AI security: preventive analysis of AI-generated code, LLM safety, AI transparency protocols.
- Data and infrastructure: vector databases, system architecture, microservices, cloud, data
  science.
- Engineering leadership: scaling teams, technical strategy, hiring, mentoring, engineering
  culture.
- Domains: FinTech, E-commerce, EdTech, PropTech, SaaS, AI Security, HealthTech.

## Coaching and advisory

- [Book a 1:1 with Shivendra](https://topmate.io/shivendra): coaching for engineers and
  engineering leaders on AI adoption, LLM product architecture, career growth, and scaling
  engineering teams.
- Available for advisory conversations on AI strategy, agentic systems, and AI security.

## Projects

- [Infrajam](https://infrajam.com): architect cloud infrastructure visually with AI — diagrams,
  cost estimates and Terraform provisioning in one workflow.
- [Vibeward](https://vibeward.dev): 'Vibe Security' for the AI era — a preventive layer that
  analyses and secures the intent of AI-generated code before the first file is written.
- [Nuum](https://nuum.online): a command center for social media growth — trend research,
  content generation and multi-channel publishing.
- [PostOracle](https://postoracle.com): an intelligent LinkedIn automation suite for networking
  and engagement that keeps a human-like presence.
- [Vector Cache](https://github.com/shivendrasoni/vector-cache): open-source Python library that
  speeds up LLM queries through semantic caching, cutting latency and token cost.
- [AITM Protocol](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/ai-transparency-markup-aitm-protocol-agent-text-voice-shivendra-soni-rawef):
  AI Transparency Markup, a protocol for AI agent self-identification in text and voice.
- Medbot (in progress): turns personal health records into insight through a private RAG
  pipeline for trend analysis and natural language querying.
